thread:
emily.sales: Customer on GCP wants a 10-day Dedicated POC. Must present a single outbound IP for allowlisting and wants to know whether we can issue per-environment API tokens. Also curious about cost estimate and who owns TLS termination.
omar.eng: We support per-project tokens for Dedicated and can TTL them. Cost: pro-rated Dedicated SKU + setup. I'll pull numbers from finance.
jay.network: On GCP we can reserve a static External IP and attach via Cloud NAT or use a VM-based NAT gateway. For single /32, reserve an external static IP and ensure NAT is pinned to it. If they want multi-zone HA without IP change, we need to use a NAT gateway backed by a reserved IP and control failover path.
emily.sales: They asked about IP rotation during scaling. Is the static IP guaranteed?
jay.network: We can guarantee the address for the POC as long as we don't enable cross-region scaling or automatic multi-zone failover. We'll list that as a constraint in the POC SOW.
rachel.solutions: TLS termination: For Dedicated with public egress, TLS will terminate at our edge. For private peering (VPC peering + private endpoint) TLS can be end-to-end. We'll clarify in the security answers.
provision-bot: Created task PROV-7012 to reserve IP 198.51.100.22 and schedule Dedicated cluster. ETA 72h.
emily.sales: Sample curl/test I can send to customer?
jay.network:
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.eu1.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
omar.eng: Also add note about allowing hostname plus IP in case their firewall does SNI checks.
emily.sales: Thanks. I'll include options in the email: (1) reserve single static IP + timeboxed token (fast), (2) private VPC peering (slower, zero public IP).
